signIn.title: Welcome to CELLR
signIn.subtitle: Your personal intelligent wine cellar.
signIn.emailHint: We'll email you a 6-digit code. No password needed.
signIn.resent: A new code is on its way.

onboarding.householdSubtitle: A household is the people who share one cellar. You can invite others any time.
onboarding.codeHint: Ask whoever invited you for the code.
onboarding.nameSubtitle: Your name appears next to your ratings and in the household.

home.heroEmpty: Add a few bottles and I'll help you decide what to open.
home.emptyBody: Scan a bottle and it appears here, beautifully.

cellar.title: Cellar
cellar.emptyBody: Every bottle you add will live here, with where it is and when to open it.

scan.title: Scan a bottle
scan.soonBody: Soon you'll point your camera at a label and we'll do the rest.

sommelier.title: Sommelier
sommelier.soonBody: Ask what to open tonight, and why. It gets good once your cellar has a few bottles.

profile.title: Profile
profile.inviteBody: Share this code. It works for 7 days and for up to 5 people.
profile.inviteShareText: Join our wine cellar on CELLR with this code: {code}
profile.leaveConfirm: Leave {household}? You'll lose access to its cellar until someone invites you again.

errors.network: We couldn't reach CELLR. Check your connection and try again.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You don't have access to that.
errors.VALIDATION: Something in that doesn't look right. Please check it and try again.
errors.CONFLICT: That can't be done right now.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: That's a lot of tries in a short time. Give it a minute and try again.
errors.AI_UNAVAILABLE: Our sommelier is taking a break. Please try again in a moment.
errors.UPLOAD_REJECTED: We couldn't use that photo. Try another one.
errors.INVITE_INVALID: That invite code didn't work. Check it, or ask for a new one.
errors.OTP_INVALID: That code didn't work. Check it, or ask for a new one.
errors.SIGNUP_CLOSED: CELLR is invite-only for now, and this email isn't on the list yet.
errors.INTERNAL: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.

offline.title: You're offline
offline.body: CELLR needs a connection for this. Your bottles are safe — reconnect and pick up where you left off.

notFound.title: We couldn't find that page.
notFound.body: It may have moved, or the link is out of date.

errorPage.title: Something went wrong on our side.
errorPage.body: Your bottles are safe. Please try again.
